games.name: Honor of Kings
games.gameplay: Honor of Kings delivers fast-paced 5v5 MOBA battles with deep strategic layers. Players control myth-inspired heroes, secure jungle objectives, and dominate compact three-lane maps. Strong emphasis on rotations, positioning, and team coordination makes every ranked match highly competitive 🔥🎯.

games.name: Arena of Valor
games.gameplay: Arena of Valor offers classic 5v5 MOBA gameplay designed for global audiences. Featuring DC heroes, mythological warriors, and balanced lane combat, the game focuses on accessible mechanics while still rewarding strategic team fights and objective control 🏆✨.

faqs.question: Which game has deeper strategy?
faqs.answer: Honor of Kings offers deeper strategic gameplay with stronger emphasis on rotations, objective control, and coordinated team fights 🔥.

faqs.question: Is Arena of Valor beginner-friendly?
faqs.answer: Yes 👍 Arena of Valor is easier for new players due to simpler hero kits and structured gameplay modes.

faqs.question: Which game has a larger player base?
faqs.answer: Honor of Kings has a significantly larger global player base, especially in China 🌍.

faqs.question: Are both games free to play?
faqs.answer: Yes 🆓 both Honor of Kings and Arena of Valor are free to download with optional cosmetic purchases.
